clues: This city is a main town hub in the East Bay. It lies east of San Francisco, in the state of California.
This land flips its rain with the seasons. Summers are warm and dry, and winters are cool and wet, with rain in the cold months.
This city was founded in 1869 by a ranch man from an old land-owning family. Its first name was later changed to the name it keeps now.
This city leads its own city area, kept apart from its big bay-area neighbors. Its area stands on its own, east of the great bay.
This is the tenth biggest city in the San Francisco Bay Area. That rank makes it a top-ten city by the bay.
